status: prepared only; coordinating agent must verify disk and release execution under existing authorization
purpose: Bounded CPU/GC and source-span investigation of repeated verified-history work; no performance gate, optimization or release verdict
seed_disclosure: Fixture creation uses 273 original untimed sole-writer calls (one 1728-unit bulk receipt plus 272 individuals), plus 16 original claim/fail pairs for terminal history; <=12 applies to additional profiled saves, not construction of the frozen fixture.
fixture_reuse: Seed once using the original frozen harness and clone equal histories for A/B. No admission or retry-proof writes are added. Existing previous studies retain their invariant evidence.
profile_scope: Actual recordStaffInventoryV2 transactions; no HTTP handler, synthetic identify lease, metadata verification, worker/provider load, UI or browser. Three concurrent callers live in the profiled intake process; this is source-cost attribution, not topology or latency qualification.
source_overlays: AST-positioned timing wrappers/counter only in owned snapshots; no original statement removed/reordered and no canonical source write. Seal exact original and instrumented bytes and hashes before DB startup.

boundaries.name: verify_and_parse_history_page
boundaries.kind: synchronous from before rows.map through complete WorkflowPageInputV2.parse return

profile_output: source and SQL spans with save correlation/monotonic+perf-time anchors
analysis: CPU sample attribution and inclusive versus exclusive/overlapping spans must be distinguished. Report schema/canonical/hash/verification/replay/Prisma/GC/probe costs; do not sum nested inclusive timings. Count repeated reads/pages/replays and correlate GC/loop stalls. No A/B performance superiority or gate verdict from 6 saves per arm.
probe_overhead: CPU sampler, AsyncLocalStorage, counters, spans, proxy awaits and GC observer perturb execution; overhead unquantified. No forced GC; all fixture setup and verification of final state are outside profile capture.
stop_conditions: 10-minute overall cap, with work stopped at 9.5 minutes and final 30 seconds reserved for owned cleanup
free space below 2 GiB during setup/profile (separate runner polls every second); launch requires an additional 256 MiB reserve
save failure, duplicated/missing job or changed prior history
next_decision: Review profile with coordinating agent and Atlas before any source-writer optimization. Preserve locks, atomic component events, journal verification, backdated replay, exact retries and one-job semantics.
supervision: Runner directly supervises installed embedded-postgres initdb/postgres binaries in owned process groups, using an owned mode-0600 password file removed after initdb. No library-start timeout race, new dependency or credential export. Only the created loopback cluster and child groups may be signalled. Preserve owned data on an unconfirmed stop; emit cleanup receipt.
disk_estimate: Source trees total 10,292,330 logical bytes; remove each ~5.5 MB owned tar after sealing its ledger. Estimated peak 120-140 MiB including the prior ~109 MB setup footprint and small profiles, not a guaranteed upper bound. One cloned DB at a time; no dependency/client copies. Require 256 MiB launch reserve above the unchanged 2 GiB floor.
interruption: SIGINT and SIGTERM are handled by the runner: record the signal, abort only owned detached groups, escalate unresponsive command groups after 5 seconds, and enter the same finally cleanup before exit. Signals never call process.exit directly. SIGKILL or OS failure cannot be trapped.
save_failure_stop: A shared stop flag is set immediately when a save rejects or its outcome assertion fails; every session checks it before starting another transaction. Already-started transactions settle through Promise.allSettled. Preserve partial output and reject the arm; do not fill skipped samples or continue to B.
